content.title: Who is Braylon Mullins' father? Is the UConn star the son of Chris Mullin?
content.text: The UConn Huskies continue to establish themselves as one of the premier talent factories in college basketball, and during the 2025-26 season, one of the most exciting names has been freshman guard Braylon Mullins. However, his last name has sparked a common question among fans: is he related to NBA legend Chris Mullin?To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoThe short answer is no. Despite the similarity in their last names-with a slight difference in spelling-there is no family connection between the two.Who is Braylon Mullins' father?The young standout's father is Josh Mullins, who also has a background in basketball. He played at the college level for Lincoln Trail College and later at Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI), which helps explain Braylon's strong foundation in the sport.While he never reached the professional level or the spotlight of bigger names, Josh Mullins provided a solid basketball upbringing that is now evident in his son's development within the NCAA.Braylon Mullins' rise at UConnOriginally from Greenfield, Indiana, Braylon Mullins arrived at UConn as one of the top prospects in the 2025 recruiting class. Standing at 6-foot-6, he quickly earned playing time in a deep rotation led by head coach Dan Hurley.In his freshman season, Mullins averaged 12.1 points, 3.5 rebounds, and 1.5 assists per game, ranking among the team's most productive players. He was also named to the Big East All-Freshman Team and delivered key performances in the NCAA Tournament, including a 17-point outing against UCLA.Why the confusion with Chris Mullin?The confusion is understandable. Chris Mullin is a basketball icon-a five-time NBA All-Star and Hall of Famer with an illustrious career in both the NBA and international competition.However, beyond the similar last name and shared basketball ties, there is no relation. Braylon Mullins is carving out his own path, with roots in the sport through his father, but building a distinct identity of his own.A name to watchWith potential to become a high pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Braylon Mullins is already making a name for himself. And while he isn't related to Chris Mullin, his talent suggests that the Mullins name could soon gain recognition at the professional level in its own right.
